checks_run.procedure: Judge F-DG4-143 against ADR-0037 N4 item 4 (Unknown, Stale, n/a and known zero stay distinct), with my own world C. Read the T10 Value RAG lines through the API, then the real T10 screen in EN and AR. Then intercept the API response and rewrite only that line's status to 'unknown', so the real web code renders an unknown line. In run 2 (dom-r5b) the rewritten line also carries the API's own unknown reason.
checks_run.command: dom-r5.mjs in stack-run-1; dom-r5b.mjs in stack-run-2

checks_run.procedure: Confirm the assignment's operating-logic list through the integration and acceptance suites, my API probes and the unchanged non-web modules. The list covers: calculations, benefits, Finance validation, benefit types, SLAs, escalation, the blocker rule, meetings, corrective actions, status separation, BAU, after closure, G5 and G6, waivers, the Modular G3 waiver, change requests, dashboards and traceability. Judge QA-C O-2, QA-B's 409 and FE-R8's KPI-variance observation. Re-judge the register's partial disclosures.
checks_run.command: integration run as DOM-R5-03; dom-api as DOM-R5-04; git diff --stat ccc37c9..3e3a06e (no api/worker/shared change); read apps/web/src/pages/kpi/KpiPage.tsx Variance and kpi/ui.tsx KpiValue
checks_run.expected: The rules match their sources, and the observations and partial disclosures are acceptable.
checks_run.actual: The A01-A14 acceptance and backend suites pass 1985/1985, and no API, worker or shared module changed since round 4. RAG comes from the KPI trajectory, never completion: a KPI with actuals but no trajectory stays Unknown. Forecast, submitted, upside and scenario values never count as validated. Finance validation is FIN-only, and an amendment keeps the chain. A non-financial benefit is n/a. Allocations over 100 % are refused, and links over 110 %. Escalation happens once, to the next authority, in working days on the calendar. The blocker rule creates one T16 ask. Quorum is enforced and published minutes are immutable. There is one corrective case per source. Closure is refused while value is pending unless a transition decision exists. BAU acceptance is by the receiver only, and it creates the recurring reviews once. After closure, the areas, the KPI actuals and the CI backlog continue, and reopening keeps the originals. G5 requires risk closure and the scale scope. G6 requires ownership transfer. Waivers carry an expiry and a compensating action. The Modular G3 waiver (D-110, ADR-0021 W1-W7) covers missing links only, and approval is refused when it is revoked or expired. A change request keeps its originals. QA-C O-2 (a record stays draft until activated while G1-G6 progress) is acceptable: the playbook defines phases and gates (B0010-B0016), not a record lifecycle, and the DG1-approved explicit transition draft->active is the activation. I exercised it in world U. QA-B (409 on a Draft gate) is the DG2-approved contract, and REQ-S04-010 only requires rejection. FE-R8's observation is that a not_computable KPI actual makes Variance read 'Unknown' with the actual's reason, while the value cell reads 'Not computable'. I accept it as an observation, not a defect: the variance is genuinely undeterminable, it is never 0 or green, and the KPI contract (DG3) has no n/a variance state. N4 item 4 concerns dashboard values. The register's partial disclosures (PB-065, PB-066, PB-075, S04-010, S04-014, S07-005, S07-007, S07-015, S08-006, S08-015, S13-003, S15-008, S20-011) are unchanged, honest and acceptable.

summary: PASS, no new finding. Candidate 69b7412a was verified in a complete clone. The T-DG4-FE-R8 repair holds on the real stack in EN and AR. F-DG4-143: an n/a Value RAG line reads 'Not applicable' / 'لا ينطبق' with its reason and never 'Unknown', and an unknown line reads 'Unknown' / 'غير معروف', as ADR-0037 N4 item 4 requires. F-DG4-144: with a 53-transformation unit, narrowing by status (and phase) lifts the 50 limit and sends exactly the matching ids, the transformation chip works beyond the unit's first page, 'none_matching' and 'none' are distinct, and the API is unchanged. This holds on the Overview, Finance and adoption dashboards. The repair diff is web-only and weakens nothing. The full review re-ran: validators PASS; integration 1985/1985; dom-api 49/49, dom-ui 38/38, dom-gross4 131/131, dom-pct 4/4, dom-kpiunit 51/51 (run alone), dom-r5b 57/57. Disclosed and explained: one load flake per Node version in the unit run (raid.test.tsx on Node 22; architecture.test.ts 30 s timeout plus a Vitest RPC timeout on Node 24), each passing twice alone. dom-kpiunit failed in the combined stack because of a worker backlog. My own dom-r5 probe flaw was fixed in dom-r5b.
